blocks.title: »genius«
blocks.text:
The high-precision Universal measuring machine
for tool manufacturers and Grinders

Request more information now

blocks.body:
As a tool manufacturer or grinding shop, you must deliver the highest quality. The »genius« universal measuring machine provides you with exact measurement data that serves as irrefutable proof of the high production quality of your products.

With ZOLLER »genius,« you can measure over 100 parameters of your precision tools in 2D/3D—non-contact, fully automatic, and with impressive reliability. This way, every measured value provides the foundation for improving the quality of your products.

Request now 1:1 expert meeting

Calibrating measuring machines on-site using certified test specimens and reference standards is an important part of E. ZOLLER GmbH & Co. KG’s quality assurance process—this ensures reliable measurement results and the high precision of your products in accordance with applicable standards.

items: Absolute measuring accuracy and process reliability

spots.label: Storage options
spots.text:
Storage options

Storage options –

The integrated storage compartments accommodate adapter tool posts and intermediate sleeves: those for intermediate sleeves are located in the interior, and those for adapter tool posts are mounted on the sides. This way, your accessories are always at hand.

spots.label: »Cockpit« Control Unit
spots.text:
»Cockpit« Control Unit

»Cockpit« Control Unit –

offers operators ergonomic design and comfort through customizable adjustment options. The »cockpit« can be adjusted for height and position, and the 24-inch TFT color monitor can also be tilted.

spots.label: Software »Pilot 4.0«
spots.text:
Software »Pilot 4.0«

Software »Pilot 4.0« –

is intuitive, with a clear overview, and enables operators to perform reliable measurements. It offers a uniform user interface across all ZOLLER systems—including ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions. The software’s modular design allows for customer-specific adjustments that can be implemented quickly.

spots.label: incident light camera
spots.text:
incident light camera

Incident light camera with Multi-LED segment illumination and CNC swiveling device –

for inspection and automatic measurement of tool geometries on the circumference, in the chip space, and on the end face. Simply enter the target parameters in the Measuring program dialog, and each measurement parameter is automatically measured and recorded: rake angle, clearance angle, Groove contour, chamfer width, and many other geometries. The high-performance LEDs, segmented into eight areas, are automatically controlled by the measuring system and ensure optimal lighting of the surface through automatic intensity control—for high precision and repeatability.

spots.label: control cabinet
spots.text:
control cabinet

control cabinet –

The execution of the control cabinet includes active ventilation. All necessary electronic components are carefully and securely installed to ensure trouble-free operation. The position of the control cabinet ensures optimal accessibility during maintenance and service work.

spots.label: High-Precision »»ace« Spindle«
spots.text:
High-Precision »»ace« Spindle«

»»ace«« high-precision spindle –

guarantees μm-accurate mounting and clamping of all types of tools and tool holders. Adaptation to many tool holder systems is ensured by the universal adapter tool post changing system. The CNC drive with autofocus and a precise Angle measuring system provides automatic focusing on the tool cutting edge and for holding the cutting contour.

spots.label: transmitted light camera
spots.text:
transmitted light camera

Transmitted light camera with Multi-LED illumination –

featuring high-quality, low distortion optics and telecentric transmitted light, it enables μm-accurate measurement of cutting edge contours and step geometry in Silhouette mode with up to 5 Mpx. The camera features a high frame rate for fast focusing and contour scanning during tool rotation. The Multi-LED ring light provides bright, high-contrast lighting for cutting edge inspection using incident light.

spots.label: Ergonomic One-Hand Control Handle »»eQ««
spots.text:
Ergonomic One-Hand Control Handle »»eQ««

Ergonomic one-hand control handle »»eQ«« (ergonomic and quick) –

for effortlessly moving the measuring axes in the X, Y, and Z directions to the correct position. The button with the Solutions icon can be configured with additional practical functions, making operation even simpler and more convenient.

With ZOLLER »genius«, you can measure virtually any aspect of a tool—precisely, fully automatic, and non-contact. No matter how complex the tool is.

ZOLLER Multi-sensor technology: »ace« high-precision spindle

blocks.title: Multi-sensor technology
blocks.text: With »genius«,« you can perform non-contact measurements using transmitted and incident light—benefit from ZOLLER’s Multi-sensor technology, optimally tailored to the specialized conditions of precision tools. The centered Multi-LED ring lights ensure ideal lighting for inspections of the end face, circumference, and chip space on every tool.

blocks.body:
Quality management requirements are constantly increasing. That is why you need to be able to rely on the consistent measurement deviations of your machines. In ZOLLER measuring machines, length measurement deviations are determined using high-precision Calibration standards made of Borofloat glass® in accordance with the DIN EN ISO 10360 standard. In accordance with this standard, at least three measurement sequences (25,326 relationships) are performed. This procedure documents the two-dimensional accuracy of ZOLLER measuring machines and ensures traceability at all times.

One-dimensional Two-dimensional

blocks.title: Two-dimensional
blocks.text: Based on DIN EN ISO 10360, Exy = 2.5 μm + (L/250 mm) μm

blocks.title: One-dimensional
blocks.text: According to VDI/VDE 2617, Ex = 1.5 μm + (L/300 mm) μm
